audit.stop_reason: C0001/C0004/C0005 were semantically rederived from the expanded allowed 015 basis. Remaining gaps are L4 output shape/value mapping for target_correspondence, current_source_material target representation, original classification/authority state, retained wrappers/empty lineage, finding pointer encoding and whole_registry_verified. These gaps are reported root by root; actual_* and operation_effect are derived from L4 declared no-writer/no-side-effect semantics, not from absence of runtime evidence.

population_and_remaining.representative_basis: 47個のfailure classを適用可能なphaseごとに数えると、class×phaseが80件となり、positive case 11件を加えて代表は91件。
population_and_remaining.population_note: 現在のunit_casesにはC0001–C0585の585行があり、#3943でmergeされたC0584/C0585を含む。91 + 494 = 585で、非代表の494件は残る代表88件とは別の集合。
population_and_remaining.mapping_status: 91代表の全ID対応は未確定。88は選定済み3件以外の予定代表数、494は母集団の算術上の残数であり、case単位の再導出完了数ではない。

legacy_and_failure_basis.disposition: 意味を再導出し、source/authorityの区別、original event/history、projectionの分離を保持する。旧世代のruntime/schema/testは再利用しない。
legacy_and_failure_basis.failure_basis: 旧PLANは、plan_registryのprojectionに型付きworkflow identityがなく、consumerが旧分類へfallbackし得たと記録している。malformed/partial tupleも記録済みのfailure modeである。これは過去のfailure contextであり、現行authorityやtest evidenceではない。
legacy_and_failure_basis.change_from_legacy: 現行L3/L10/L4のsourceからOS015のsource/event/classification/authorityの意味を再導出し、旧DB projection modelを移植しない。

audit.post_derivation_comparison: After the blind derivation was fixed, Codex compared seven scalar roots and current_source_material against existing expectations; see issue #3510 comment 6529774668. The scalar roots matched, but the blind single-boolean interpretation differs from the existing per-target object. Other roots remain unexamined in that comparison.

fixed_derivation_artifact.limitation: Semantic descriptions and provisional scalar interpretation, not a complete serialized oracle.

revision_history: Blind worker fixed e96d09af before Codex compared seven scalar roots and current_source_material against existing expectations; issue 3510 comment 6529774668.

After the partial comparison, the audit was expanded to include L4 contracts 0–3 and allowed L10 observations/failure classifications. The blind worker had not read existing expected values; Codex later revised this audit with knowledge of the comparison.

In the fixed artifact current_source_material was a provisional single boolean (true/false/false), and whole_registry_verified was false. The current audit records both as partial_unknown for serialized output, because the L4 mapping/type is not specified. No post-comparison expected value is adopted.
Other rows are semantic descriptions, not claims that every frozen value has a verified output serialization. Exact comparison is limited to the eight named roots; remaining roots were not compared.
